diff_summary: The 277-venue atlas is strong where the tracker already lives - TRAI, DoT eServices, NCCS, TDSAT, MeitY, MIB, CERT-In, UIDAI, BIS, RBI, courts and the gazette/PIB safety net - and roughly 85-90% of the fresh statute-first enumeration maps onto an existing atlas entry. The gaps cluster four ways. (1) Seven regulators/venues are entirely absent: CCA (IT Act ch.VI), Press Council of India, DGFT (IT-hardware import management), IN-SPACe/DoS (space authorisation), NIXI/.IN Registry, India Semiconductor Mission, and CBC - plus the SFLC internetshutdowns.in tracker, Lumen, Bar & Bench and LiveLaw on the disclosure side. (2) High-value listing pages are missing on regulators the atlas thinks it covers: TEC circulars and gazette-notified standards, NCCS HQ circulars, TRAI financial-disincentive and miscellaneous orders (the latter contradicting the registry's recorded belief that no orders listing exists), eServices RoW and satellite/GMPCS pages, CBFC important-communications, NBDSA advisories, MIB Engage, all four CCI legal-framwork listings, and the Legislative Department's live acts-in-pdf/ordinances listings (the atlas wrote the site off as an empty shell). (3) Unmapped migrations are silently breaking coverage: DoCA moved to consumeraffairs.gov.in while the atlas only holds the timing-out nic.in host; UIDAI's entire legal-framework path 404s and the planned uidai_circulars URL in sources.json is dead (new flat /en/ listings verified); CCI combination orders moved to /combination/orders-section31; Karnataka and Maharashtra gazette hosts are stale/misspelt in the atlas. (4) Standing structural gaps need decisions, not scrapers: no working CCPA venue anywhere, no UP or WB online gazette, DPB and OGAI still siteless (watch), Sahyog login-gated, and several NIC hosts India-geo-fenced. The 40-entry worklist takes all 16 surviving planned sources (meity_whatsnew dropped as retired; three planned URLs corrected in place) plus 24 additions; missing-core rows that fell below the cap - CCI framework listings, DGFT public notices/circulars, DoCA CP-acts, BIS act-rules shelf, CRS dashboard, Legislative acts/ordinances, PCI norms/adjudications, CBFC imp-comms, NBDSA advisories, PRGI title guidelines and Delhi notifications - are the next tranche and are all captured in missing_from_atlas with exact URLs.
